description.zh: 过滤条件键。取值见下方`支持的过滤参数`。
description.en: The key of the filter condition. For information about valid values, see the "`Supported filter parameters`" section below.

description.zh:
匹配方式。

取值为Equals，表示相等匹配。
description.en:
The matching method.

Set this parameter to `Equals`, which means an equal match.
The values of the filter condition.

description.zh:
资源数量统计的分组维度。取值：
- ResourceType：资源类型。
- RegionId：地域。
- ResourceGroupId：资源组ID。
description.en:
The dimension by which the queried resources are grouped. Valid values:

- ResourceType: The resource type.

- RegionId: The region.

- ResourceGroupId: The resource group ID.

Specifies whether to include deleted resources. Valid values:

- true

- false

description.zh: 搜索关键词。资源中心会根据相关性对搜索结果进行过滤。
description.en: The search keyword. Resource Center filters the search results based on relevance.

title.zh: 查询当前账号下的资源数量

descriptions.zh:
- 仅能搜索当前账号下有权限访问的资源数量。
- 仅能搜索[支持资源中心的云服务及资源类型](~~477798~~)。
descriptions.en:
- You can query the number of resources in your account that you have permission to access.

- You can query only the [Alibaba Cloud services and resource types that are supported by Resource Center](~~477798~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcecenter get-resource-counts --group-by-key ResourceType --filter '[{"MatchType":"Equals","Value":["cn-shanghai"],"Key":"RegionId"}]' --search-expression keywords --include-deleted-resources true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcecenter GetResourceCounts --region cn-hangzhou --Filter.1.MatchType Equals --GroupByKey ResourceType --Filter.1.Value.1 'cn-shanghai' --IncludeDeletedResources true --SearchExpression keywords --Filter.1.Key RegionId
